I suggest you to don't look for shortcuts. Marketpedia gives you the track and sequence to follow.

If you try to cut some step now you will be back to those steps in the future due to lack of understanding.

Take all the time it needs, don't be in a hurry. Patience is the most important thing to learn for a profitable trader

Hi guys and especially IF,

I found an article that is very interesting to read and kind of similair to how markets work:

 www.huffingtonpost.com/tobias-stone/hist...rump_b_11179774.html

This is one part of that article:

"My point is that this is a cycle. It happens again and again, but as
most people only have a 50-100 year historical perspective they don’t
see that it’s happening again. As the events that led to the First World
 War unfolded, there were a few brilliant minds who started to warn that
 something big was wrong, that the web of treaties across Europe could
lead to a war, but they were dismissed as hysterical, mad, or fools, as
is always the way, and as people who worry about Putin, Brexit and Trump
 are dismissed now.

But at the time people don’t realize they’re embarking on a route that
will lead to a destruction period. They think they’re right, they’re
cheered on by jeering angry mobs, their critics are mocked. This cycle,
the one we saw for example from the Treaty of Versaille, to the rise of
Hitler, to the Second World War, appears to be happening again. But as
with before, most people cannot see it because:

1. They are only looking at the present, not the past or future

2. They are only looking immediately around them, not at how events connect globally

3. Most people don’t read, think, challenge or hear opposing views"

I had my tinfoil hat while reading this

Have a nice day everyone
